title: ADVANCES IN LLM REASONING ENABLE FLEXIBILITY IN CLINICAL PROBLEM-SOLVING
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM reasoning flexibility in clinical problem-solving using a medical QA benchmark (mARC) designed to test susceptibility to the Einstellung effect (a cognitive bias). It does not contain a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics in LLMs. The mention of 'Ethical approval' in the methods refers to the study's own ethical compliance regarding human participants, not an evaluation of LLMs on ethics.
